end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as one ten and some ones using bundles and loose sticks.
Saanvi identified the loose 4 in 14 but was unsure about the ten and ones parts.
The tens/ones mix-up was not corrected before the lesson ended.
Lesson stopped at Saanvi’s request after about 1 minute.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making 14 with one bundle of ten and four loose sticks. They connected the final digit 4 with the loose sticks, but the meaning of the first digit as one group of ten was still mixed up and was not corrected before stopping. At home, use sticks or pencils to make 14 as one bundle of 10 plus 4 separate ones, and say the parts aloud together.
